unread.title: The natural history of heterotopic ossification in patients who have fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva. A study of forty-four patients.
unread.why: This 44-patient natural-history study provides quantitative endpoints and timelines for heterotopic-ossification onset and mobility decline in FOP.

unread.title: An Acvr1 R206H knock-in mouse has fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva.
unread.why: This knock-in model reproduces malformed digits and progressive endochondral heterotopic ossification and provides a direct in vivo platform for FOP research.

unread.title: Early mortality and cardiorespiratory failure in patients with fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva.
unread.why: Analysis of two registries covering more than 90% of known FOP patients establishes mortality, lifespan, and major clinical endpoints for natural-history and trial studies.

unread.title: Palovarotene Inhibits Heterotopic Ossification and Maintains Limb Mobility and Growth in Mice With the Human ACVR1(R206H) Fibrodysplasia Ossificans Progressiva (FOP) Mutation.
unread.why: Palovarotene prevents spontaneous heterotopic ossification and preserves mobility, growth, and survival outcomes in a genetically accurate FOP mouse model.

unread.title: Early diagnosis of fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva.
unread.why: The study validates clinical recognition and early DNA testing of FOP before heterotopic ossification appears, preventing trauma-associated diagnostic harm.

unread.title: Transgenic mice overexpressing BMP4 develop a fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (FOP)-like phenotype.
unread.why: This study establishes a transgenic mouse model with an FOP-like heterotopic ossification phenotype and experimentally demonstrates prevention with BMP inhibition.

unread.title: In vivo somatic cell gene transfer of an engineered Noggin mutein prevents BMP4-induced heterotopic ossification.
unread.why: The study provides proof-of-concept in vivo prevention of BMP4-induced heterotopic ossification using engineered Noggin gene transfer, a strategy directly relevant to FOP.

unread.title: Substance P signaling mediates BMP-dependent heterotopic ossification.
unread.why: The study identifies Substance P/NK1 signaling as a targetable amplifier of heterotopic ossification and shows substantial inhibition in multiple models, including FOP-associated lesions.

unread.title: Palovarotene Inhibits Osteochondroma Formation in a Mouse Model of Multiple Hereditary Exostoses.
unread.why: In a genetically defined osteochondroma/BMP-signaling disorder sharing skeletal features with FOP, palovarotene dose-dependently reduced osteochondroma formation by up to 91%.

unread.title: A novel mutation of ALK2, L196P, found in the most benign case of fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva activates BMP-specific intracellular signaling equivalent to a typical mutation, R206H.
unread.why: The study experimentally establishes a reusable cellular signaling and differentiation assay profile for the FOP ALK2 L196P variant and shows its resistance to known pathway inhibitors.

unread.title: Effects of intravenous etidronate and oral corticosteroids in fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva.
unread.why: This small clinical study directly tested etidronate plus corticosteroids during 31 FOP flare-ups and reported rapid symptomatic improvement but incomplete prevention of new ossification.

unread.title: Clinically applicable antianginal agents suppress osteoblastic transformation of myogenic cells and heterotopic ossifications in mice.
unread.why: A targeted drug screen and mouse experiments identify repurposable antianginal agents, with perhexiline reducing heterotopic-ossification volume by 38%.

unread.title: Characterization of bone morphogenetic protein 4 receptor in fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva.
unread.why: This study identifies elevated BMP4 expression in patient-derived lymphoblastoid and lesional cells and provides a molecular assay for investigating FOP-associated BMP pathway dysregulation.

unread.title: Pre- and post-therapy MR imaging in fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva.
unread.why: The case provides direct evidence that MRI can identify preosseous FOP lesions and that serial imaging can document lesion resolution after early therapy.

unread.title: Garetosmab in Fibrodysplasia Ossificans Progressiva: Clinical Pharmacology Results from the Phase 2 LUMINA-1 Trial.
unread.why: The phase 2 trial directly characterizes garetosmab pharmacology, immunogenicity, BMP9 biomarker behavior, exposure-response, and safety in FOP patients.

unread.title: Difficult diagnosis and genetic analysis of fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva: a case report.
unread.why: The study demonstrates sequencing identification of a pathogenic de novo ACVR1 variant in a diagnostically challenging FOP patient.

unread.title: Performance of simplified methods for quantification of [<sup>18</sup>F]NaF uptake in fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva.
unread.why: The study validates semi-quantitative [18F]NaF PET/CT methods and TBR for longitudinally measuring active FOP bone lesions.

unread.title: Effect of Itraconazole or Rifampin on Zilurgisertib Pharmacokinetics When Administered Orally in Healthy Participants.
unread.why: This clinical pharmacology study provides tested dosing and coadministration guidance for zilurgisertib, an investigational FOP treatment.

unread.title: Comparison of PET/CT versus CT only in the assessment of new heterotopic ossification bone lesions in patients with fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva.
unread.why: The comparative FOP study provides evidence that CT alone is a viable modality for assessing new heterotopic ossification lesions in clinical trials.

unread.title: Generation of an induced pluripotent stem cell line (TRNDi012-B) from Fibrodysplasia Ossificans Progressiva (FOP) patient carrying a heterozygous mutation c. 617G > A in the ACVR1 gene.
unread.why: The generated FOP iPSC line is a disease-specific experimental model and reusable resource for studying ACVR1-mediated heterotopic ossification.

unread.title: Fibrodysplasia Ossificans Progressiva: A Case Series with Radiologic Findings.
unread.why: This FOP case series reports usable diagnostic techniques and conservative management strategies, including physiotherapy and trauma prevention to reduce disability and flares.

unread.title: A fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva patient with a rare missense mutation in ACVR1 detected on <sup>18</sup>F-FDG PET/CT.
unread.why: The study provides patient data supporting 18F-FDG PET/CT as a biomarker for active versus end-stage heterotopic ossification and potentially for monitoring treatment efficacy.

unread.title: Fibrodysplasia Ossificans Progressiva: A Case Report.
unread.why: The FOP case reports clinical use of a methylprednisolone/alendronate combination with some therapeutic efficacy, alongside diagnostic and supportive-management methods.

unread.title: All Restricted Spines are not Spondyloarthritis: Fibrodysplasia Ossificans Progressiva (FOP) in Monozygotic Twins presenting to Rheumatology Clinic.
unread.why: The report identifies palovarotene as an FDA-approved FOP therapy reducing heterotopic ossification and provides a practical clinical diagnostic and procedure-avoidance strategy.

unread.title: Evaluation of clinical cardiac safety of zilurgisertib, an activin receptor-like kinase-2 (ALK2) inhibitor, in healthy participants.
unread.why: The randomized clinical pharmacology study provides dose, pharmacokinetic, ECG, and QT safety data for zilurgisertib under development for FOP.

unread.title: First-In-Human Study to Assess the Pharmacokinetics and Safety of DS-6016a After Single Subcutaneous Injection in Healthy Japanese Adults.
unread.why: This first-in-human trial provides concrete dose, pharmacokinetic, safety, immunogenicity, and biomarker data for an ALK2-targeted therapy for FOP.

unread.title: Anesthetic and airway management for inguinal hernia repair in a pediatric patient with fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva: a case report.
unread.why: The case provides a concrete anesthesia and airway-management protocol that enabled uneventful surgery in a child with FOP without an observed flare-up.

unread.title: BMP type I receptor inhibition reduces heterotopic [corrected] ossification.
unread.why: The study develops a mouse model of FOP-like heterotopic ossification and demonstrates that LDN-193189 reduces ectopic ossification and functional impairment by inhibiting ALK2/BMP signaling.

unread.title: Fibrodysplasia (myositis) ossificans progressiva.
unread.why: This same-disease report identifies radionuclide imaging and CT as sensitive methods for detecting heterotopic bone and assisting FOP diagnosis.
